scope: Interactive /context selection on patched Pi 0.84.2; synthetic data only

requirements.contract: Select individual messages, whole turns and ranges; exclude or restore; cancel changes without affecting the input buffer
Tool calls and their results form one exclusion unit, including reused call IDs and late results
Exclude selected thinking, retain prose/tools/future thinking and restore legacy purges explicitly
Persist only decisions and stable entry IDs; keep transcript bodies unchanged; preserve decisions across reload/resume/compaction and respect branch scope
Show clearly estimated message counts and optional exact rendered-prompt token counts; tokenize without inference; failures cannot apply edits
Undo pending changes and persisted changes in reverse order without deleting transcript entries
Malformed policies, ambiguous tool IDs and filtering errors block the request rather than reintroducing excluded messages
